zh.title: Disclosures 阅读指南：TDS、SPQ、NHD
zh.description: 怎样读加州房屋披露？本文说明 TDS、SPQ、NHD、Preliminary Title Report、HOA 文件各看什么，2025–2026 年的电气、燃气和防火新要求，以及晚收到 TDS 时的法定解约期。
zh.lead: 披露资料是你判断出价和条件的基础。有意向时就读，把疑问写成清单。

en.title: Reading Disclosures: TDS, SPQ, NHD and More
en.seo_title: Reading California Home Disclosures | Jing Chen
en.description: What to look for in the TDS, SPQ, NHD, title report and HOA documents, recent California requirements, and your rights if the TDS arrives late.
en.lead: Disclosures are the basis for your price and terms. Read them early and turn anything unclear into written questions.
